```{r installing and calling Rpackages}
install.packages("Rsampling")

install.packages("pbapply")
install.packages("ggplot2")
install.packages("glmmTMB")
install.packages("DHARMa")
install.packages("dplyr")

install.packages("emmeans")
```

```{r calling Rpackages}
library(Rsampling)
library(vegan)
library(pbapply)
library(ggplot2)
library(glmmTMB)
library(DHARMa)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(emmeans)
```

```{r importing the data}
data_raw <- read.table("~/Jussara_autotomy/data/raw/data.tsv", header = T, stringsAsFactors = T, sep='\t')
```

Information that we discussed in the reunion: 
We need to make a descriptive analyses (glmm) comparing if the autotomy differ between: population (which is the collectors because they collected only 1 time each year in four different years ps: the data is temporally organized - 2002, 2009, 2011, 2012); type of leg (1,2,3 or 4); and side (right or left)

```{r transforming into a long table}
data <- data_raw[, -c(10, 11, 12)]
df_long <- data %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = r1:l4,
               names_to = "leg_id",
               values_to = "autotomy") %>%
  mutate(
    side = ifelse(grepl("^r", leg_id), "right", "left"),
    leg = gsub("[rl]", "", leg_id)
  )
```


```{r resuming the data - not necessary, just checking some infos}
df_long %>% filter(population == "MC", autotomy == 0) %>% nrow() #3538
df_long %>% filter(population == "MC", autotomy == 1) %>% nrow() #342
(3538+342)/8 # 485 (n de indivíduos em MC)
342/3880 # 0.088


```
